content.text:
**Finding submitted — GOVLAW: deviation (venue absent).**

- §14.3 gives us New York substantive law (preferred element 1, already met).
- No venue, forum, or arbitration provision exists anywhere in the document; §14.4 (jury waiver), §14.14 (two-year actions period) and §14.19 (geographic scope of delivery) do not fix a forum.
- Cure: one inserted sentence after p0171 establishing exclusive merits jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, with the customary temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out. The governing-law sentence is preserved verbatim.
